title: Bounds for Genus Zero Gromov-Witten Invariants
summary: We give a bound for the norm of each primary genus zero Gromov-Witten invariant in any smooth projective variety. This bound depends only on the maximum degree of its defining polynomials, the norms of the differential forms representing each insertion, the number of marked points and the degree of the curves. These bounds grow factorially in the number of marked points and a multiple of the degree.
